notes_for_editor: Unresolved: a September 1921 Missoulian notice (quoted by Forest Lookouts) calls the point's lookout 'in use for years' and being remodeled, while firelookout.com dates an L-4 cab to 1933. The sources do not say whether these describe the same structure, so the story gives both without choosing. The 1953 destruction date and the 1933 cab rest on a single page. The record's elevation is null; firelookout.com gives 7207 ft, which has no slot in facts. No staffing, access or photo found in the three pages read. The Forest Lookouts page quotes no other staffing or fire events for this site.
